text.text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful and I truly enjoyed my stay. The standout highlight of our trip was Alonzo. I’ve stayed at many high-end hotels, and Alonzo’s professionalism and efficiency are top-tier. He handled our requests with such speed and grace that it made our entire stay seamless. It’s clear he understands the industry inside and out. His attention to detail and proactive attitude are qualities you just can’t teach. He made us feel so valued that we’ve already decided this will be our 'go-to' hotel whenever we are in town. If the management team is looking for a model of what perfect customer service looks like, they need to look at Alonzo. The room was a perfect size and we had a balcony with a great view.

text.text:
My husband and I traveled to Miami for the boat show and truly enjoyed our stay. While the rooms are on the smaller side and modest, they are exceptionally clean and very comfortable — exactly what you need after a full day at the show. It is evident that the housekeeping staff take great pride in ensuring cleanliness and comfort for their guests.

The location is fantastic. It’s within easy walking distance to the conference center, wonderful restaurants, and the beach, which made everything incredibly convenient. Additionally, the hotel restaurant was exceptional with “half price drinks” Happy Hour daily.

The true highlight of our visit, however, was Abdullah at the front desk. While others were not as accommodating, Abdullah was genuinely pleasant, kind, and  welcoming. More than that, he made it his personal mission to ensure our stay was comfortable and seamless. His attentiveness and positive spirit made a lasting impression on us.

We are grateful for the hospitality and would absolutely stay again.

text.text:
Read the one star reviews before you consider booking this hotel, I don’t say this lightly but they have probably paid for these 5 star reviews.

Stayed here a few weeks ago (NYE 2026).. Got downgraded to a lesser room without being told by the staff. We only found out we got downgraded because we booked the same rooms with friends and saw the difference when we visited their rooms. When we brought this up to the staff and asked to pay for the price difference between rooms, they said they couldn’t help us and offered to waive the hotel fee (this is an additional charge everyone pays upon check-in.) We obviously were not satisfied with this, demanded to pay for the lesser room we were in and asked to connect with the manager. We were only given an email. Apparently the manager is never on-site (convenient, mind you this was over New Year’s Eve, and the hotel was fully booked according to them). Never received a response from the 3 emails we sent, countlessly talked to reception and were never helped. We ended up paying for a premium room while staying in a standard. We weren’t even asking for a discount, we only wanted to pay for the difference in price.

Beyond that, rooms had mold, literal blood stain in the bathroom, dust everywhere, unsanitary and the shower is quite literally in the middle of the room (no exaggeration.) I can’t emphasize enough, read the 1 star reviews because those are accurate and I made the mistake of overlooking this before booking with them.
